entities.summary: Ibrahim ibn Adham also called Ibrahim Balkhi and Ebrahim-e Adham ; c. 718 – c. 782 / AH c. 100 – c. 165 is one of the most prominent of the early Sufi saints known for his zuhd (asceticism).
